query:
UPDATE
            email_sync_streams s
        SET
            next_run_at = GREATEST(LEAST(s.next_run_at, now()), s.provider_retry_at)
        FROM
            email_links l
        WHERE
            l.id = $1
            AND l.grant_generation = $2
            AND l.sync_generation = $3
            AND l.is_sync_active
            AND s.link_id = l.id
            AND s.generation = l.sync_generation
